findings.summary: Pager action is rendered as an anchor acting as a button instead of a native button.
findings.consequence: The control is keyboard-handled, but it loses native button semantics and disabled behavior consistency with the adjacent previous/next controls, making the pager harder to reason about and test for assistive technology behavior.
findings.evidence: Line 1785 renders `Gå till första träffen`; line 1788 repeats the same pattern for the last-page action. The surrounding previous/next actions at lines 1765-1782 are already native `
findings.recommendation: Use `<button type="button">` for these command actions, with the same click handlers and explicit disabled state when already on the target page.
